_comment: Lista de sunete pentru tools/audio/generate.py. type: sfx | loop | music. duration în secunde. volume = volumul implicit din manifest (0..1). Promptul nu numește artiști, jocuri sau melodii reale.

Dark gothic instrumental for the title screen of a grotesque horror roguelike. Slow mournful pipe organ chords, a soft wordless choir humming (no lyrics), a fragile detuned music-box melody like a twisted childhood lullaby, low cello drones. Melancholic, eerie, sparse. 70 BPM, D minor. Steady mood from start to end, no big intro and no ending, suitable for seamless looping.
